title: Block 2 Revision & Excel Challenge
source: ICT Grade 3 (Nile International) Block 2 Week 5 Revision and Excel Challenge (pp.46-50)

scenes.t: A data logger collects and saves data. A sensor detects or measures something. A probe helps a sensor take a measurement.
A temperature sensor measures temperature. An ultrasonic sensor measures distance. A touch sensor detects touch.
GPS helps us find our location. Geo-tagging adds a location to a photo. Geo-tracking follows a moving school bus.
In Excel, rows go across and columns go down. A cell is where a row and a column meet, like B4.
Every formula starts with an equal sign. SUM adds, MAX finds the biggest, and MIN finds the smallest.
A chart shows data visually. A pie chart looks like a circle divided into slices.
